lessons.title: The night-sky image so incredible the NZ man behind it has been accused of using AI
lessons.title_zh: 紐西蘭男子的夜空攝影作品太驚人，因而被指控使用AI

paragraphs.en: Astrophotographer Brendan Larsen spent many hours capturing the night sky in New Zealand. His spectacular final image shows thousands of satellites crossing paths above Mount Taranaki on the North Island.
paragraphs.zh: 天文攝影師布蘭登·拉森花費許多時間拍攝紐西蘭的夜空。他那張壯觀的最終影像顯示，成千上萬的人造衛星在北島的塔拉納基山上方交錯而過。

paragraphs.en: To make this viral picture, Larsen left his camera running for two hours to take hundreds of individual shots. He then spent about forty hours layering the photos together and removing stars to reveal the hidden satellites.
paragraphs.zh: 為了拍出這張爆紅的照片，拉森讓相機持續運作兩小時，拍下了數百張獨立的照片。接著，他花了大約四十小時將這些照片疊加在一起，並去除星星以顯現隱藏的人造衛星。

paragraphs.en: Some online viewers dismissed the stunning photograph as artificial intelligence. Larsen explained that AI software is becoming so good that people without knowledge of astrophotography find it difficult to tell real images from fake ones.
paragraphs.zh: 一些網路觀眾將這張驚人的照片斥為人工智慧生成。拉森解釋說，AI軟體變得如此厲害，以至於不熟悉天文攝影的人很難分辨真實影像與假影像。

paragraphs.en: As a child, Larsen was deeply impressed by the starry rural skies of New Zealand. However, he has noticed a troubling increase in light pollution and space debris during his six years of photography.
paragraphs.zh: 小時候，拉森對紐西蘭鄉間滿天繁星的景象印象深刻。然而，在進行攝影的六年期間，他注意到光害與太空垃圾令人擔憂地增加。

paragraphs.en: Experts warn that metal particles from rocket launches and satellite reentries could affect the atmosphere and the ozone layer. Larsen hopes his remarkable photo will encourage people to discuss and protect the night sky responsibly.
paragraphs.zh: 專家警告，火箭發射和衛星重返大氣層產生的金屬顆粒可能會影響大氣層與臭氧層。拉森希望他這張非凡的照片能鼓勵人們討論並負責任地保護夜空。

phrases.phrase: tell real images from fake ones
phrases.zh: 分辨真實影像與假影像

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 用現在分詞 stunning 來修飾名詞 photograph，表示該照片本身具有令人驚豔的特質。
grammar.example: Some online viewers dismissed the stunning photograph as artificial intelligence.

grammar.point: 目的不定詞片語 (Infinitive Phrase of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用不定詞片語 to reveal the hidden satellites 來表達花費四十小時疊加照片的目的。
grammar.example: He then spent about forty hours layering the photos together and removing stars to reveal the hidden satellites.

grammar.explain: 使用被動語態 are becoming so good (在此為連綴動詞與形容詞構成狀態，另一句為被動結構) 或由 be + 過去分詞構成的被動語態，此處展示原文字句中的被動與狀態變化用法。
grammar.example: Larsen explained that AI software is becoming so good that people without knowledge of astrophotography find it difficult to tell real images from fake ones.

lessons.title: Graduates are managing AI - but are they learning much else?
lessons.title_zh: 畢業生正在管理人工智慧——但他們還學到了其他東西嗎？

paragraphs.en: Artificial intelligence is changing the nature of entry-level jobs. Companies are now creating special AI-focused graduate roles instead of traditional administrative positions. For example, Lotte Underwood works as an AI associate at a London-based public relations agency called Fight or Flight. Her daily tasks include managing AI agents, checking their outputs, and monitoring how clients appear in responses from AI tools like ChatGPT.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧正在改變基層職位的性質。企業現在正創造特別以人工智慧為焦點的畢業生職位，而不是傳統的行政職缺。例如，洛特·安德伍德（Lotte Underwood）在一家總部位於倫敦名為「戰鬥或逃跑」（Fight or Flight）的公關公司擔任人工智慧助理。她的日常任務包括管理人工智慧代理程式、檢查其輸出結果，並監控客戶在聊天GPT（ChatGPT）等人工智慧工具的回應中如何出現。

paragraphs.en: Similarly, Dillan Patel works as an AI automation analyst at an engineering software company named Stride. He builds internal agents and identifies repetitive tasks that technology can handle. Other companies, such as the outsourced contact centre firm ArvatoConnect, also plan to hire graduates who can challenge the organisation to think more broadly about how to apply technology and grow the business.
paragraphs.zh: 同樣地，迪蘭·帕特爾（Dillan Patel）在一家名為思特萊德（Stride）的工程軟體公司擔任人工智慧自動化分析師。他建立內部代理程式，並識別科技可以處理的重複性任務。其他公司，例如外包客服中心企業阿瓦托連線（ArvatoConnect），也計畫雇用能夠挑戰組織更廣泛思考如何應用科技及發展業務的畢業生。

paragraphs.en: Research from the consultancy PwC shows that entry-level roles influenced by AI now require traditionally senior-level skills, such as strategic decision making and motivational leadership. These roles have grown significantly over recent years. Some young workers, like Cian Clinton who joined a consultancy named Valliance, feel that using many AI agents daily helps them take on greater responsibilities much earlier in their careers.
paragraphs.zh: 顧問公司普華永道（PwC）的研究顯示，受人工智慧影響的基層職位現在需要傳統的高階技能，例如策略決策和激勵領導。這些職位近年來顯著成長。一些年輕員工，例如加入名為華利安（Valliance）顧問公司的西安·克林頓（Cian Clinton），覺得每天使用許多人工智慧代理程式有助於他們在職涯更早階段承擔更大的責任。

paragraphs.en: However, this heavy focus on technology raises questions about whether young employees are missing out on learning traditional professional skills. While some believe that critical thinking matters more than a knowledge bank, other industry experts warn that skills in technology alone are not enough. Claire Reed from PwC UK notes that graduates must combine technology with deep sector knowledge to truly succeed.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，這種對科技的重大關注引發了關於年輕員工是否錯失學習傳統專業技能機會的疑問。雖然有些人認為批判性思考比知識庫更重要，但其他產業專家警告說，單靠科技技能是不夠的。來自英國普華永道的克萊爾·里德（Claire Reed）指出，畢業生必須將科技與深厚的產業知識結合才能真正成功。

vocab.zh: 代理人；此處指AI代理程式

grammar.explain: 說明用所有格關代 whose 來引導形容詞子句，修飾前面的名詞 clients。
grammar.example: Her daily tasks include managing AI agents, checking their outputs, and monitoring how clients appear in responses from AI tools like ChatGPT.
grammar.focus: how clients appear in responses from AI tools

grammar.explain: 說明句型使用 be 動詞加過去分詞來表達被動發生的動作。
grammar.example: Similarly, Dillan Patel works as an AI automation analyst at an engineering software company named Stride.

grammar.point: 不定詞作副詞用表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 說明用 to 加原形動詞來表達做某事的目的是什麼。
grammar.example: Other companies, such as the outsourced contact centre firm ArvatoConnect, also plan to hire graduates who can challenge the organisation to think more broadly about how to apply technology and grow the business.
grammar.focus: to think more broadly about how to apply technology and grow the business

lessons.title: Lai touts Taiwan’s economic resilience
lessons.title_zh: 賴清德總統宣揚臺灣經濟韌性

paragraphs.en: President William Lai highlighted Taiwan’s impressive economic resilience and reported that the local stock market now ranks fourth globally. Speaking at an international financial event organized by the Financial Supervisory Commission and related industry groups, he thanked investors for their steady support. Despite global changes and the artificial intelligence boom, the local economy grew significantly last year and projects strong growth this year.
paragraphs.zh: 賴清德總統強調了臺灣令人印象深刻的經濟韌性，並報告當地股市目前全球排名第四。在由金融監督管理委員會及相關產業公會主辦的一場國際金融活動上，他感謝投資人給予的堅定支持。儘管面臨全球變局與人工智慧熱潮，當地經濟去年仍顯著成長，並預估今年將有強勁的成長。

paragraphs.en: To build on these strengths, the government has set three major priorities for the financial sector. First, officials want to further internationalize the local markets, attract global asset management firms, and position the island as a key hub for capital in Asia. Second, leaders aim to make the capital market more dynamic by encouraging high-quality foreign companies to list locally. Third, the administration plans to strengthen corporate governance and sustainability disclosures to build trust.
paragraphs.zh: 為了在此基礎上再接再厲，政府為金融部門設定了三大施政優先事項。首先，官方希望進一步將在地市場國際化、吸引全球資產管理公司，並將本島定位為亞洲的關鍵資本樞紐。其次，領導階層旨在透過鼓勵優質外國企業在地上市，讓資本市場更具活力。第三，政府計畫加強公司治理與永續資訊揭露以建立信任。

paragraphs.en: During the same gathering, a senior executive from NASDAQ noted that Taiwan sits right at the center of regional artificial intelligence development. He stated that equity markets can accelerate technology growth by directing money toward productive investments and lowering financing costs. Meanwhile, a US military commander warned about regional security threats, noting that defense forces are preparing based on the possibility of a 2027 invasion scenario.
paragraphs.zh: 在同一場聚會中，那斯達克的一位高階主管指出，臺灣正好位於區域人工智慧發展的中心。他表示，股票市場可以透過將資金引導至生產性投資並降低融資成本來加速科技成長。同時，一名美國軍事指揮官警告區域安全威脅，並指出防衛部隊正基於2027年遭到入侵的情境可能性來進行準備。

paragraphs.en: In other developments, a commercial flight from Taiwan recently flew through Pakistani airspace after authorities suddenly reversed a brief route ban linked to their policies. Furthermore, Taiwan expressed appreciation to foreign ministers from the United States, Japan, and South Korea for stressing peace across the Taiwan Strait at a recent trilateral meeting. Finally, Taipei lodged a protest regarding China's discriminatory handling of invitations for the upcoming APEC summit.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他動態方面，一架來自臺灣的民航機最近在當局突然推翻與其政策相關的短暫航線禁令後，飛越了巴基斯坦領空。此外，臺灣對美國、日本與南韓的外交部長在最近的一次三邊會議中強調臺灣海峽和平表達感謝。最後，臺北針對中國對即將到來的亞太經濟合作會議峰會邀請函採取歧視性處理提出抗議。

grammar.explain: 使用現在分詞片語作為附加的補充說明，省略連接詞與主詞。
grammar.example: Speaking at an international financial event organized by the Financial Supervisory Commission and related industry groups, he thanked investors for their steady support.
grammar.focus: Speaking at an international financial event

grammar.explain: 說明主詞承受動作，結構為「be動詞 + 過去分詞」。
grammar.example: An international financial event organized by the Financial Supervisory Commission and related industry groups...
grammar.focus: organized by the Financial Supervisory Commission

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」來表達某個動作執行的目的或意圖。
grammar.example: Officials want to further internationalize the local markets, attract global asset management firms, and position the island as a key hub for capital in Asia.
grammar.focus: to further internationalize the local markets

lessons.title: UK makes huge aid cuts to Commonwealth nations despite warm words at Chogm
lessons.title_zh: 英國儘管在大英國協首長會議上用詞溫和，仍對大英國協國家大幅削減援助

paragraphs.en: The United Kingdom government has made huge cuts to overseas aid for Commonwealth nations. This news was revealed by the Guardian, contrasting sharply with the warm words spoken by King Charles and Prime Minister Andy Burnham this week.
paragraphs.zh: 英國政府已大幅削減對大英國協國家的海外援助。這項消息是由《衛報》所揭露的，與查爾斯國王和首相安迪·伯納姆本周發表的溫暖言論形成強烈對比。

paragraphs.en: An analysis of aid figures shows that funding for these countries will drop from £546m in the 2024 to 2025 period down to £131m by 2028 to 2029. A large portion of this remaining money, specifically £68m, is set to go to Nigeria, leaving only £63m for all other nations.
paragraphs.zh: 一項援助數據分析顯示，這些國家的資金將從 2024 至 2025 年度的 5.46 億英鎊，降至 2028 至 2029 年度的 1.31 億英鎊。這筆剩餘資金中的很大一部分，具體為 6800 萬英鎊，將流向奈及利亞，只剩下 6300 萬英鎊給所有其他國家。

paragraphs.en: These revelations emerged while King Charles attended the Commonwealth heads of government meeting, known as Chogm, in Antigua. During the meeting, he stated that it was right to acknowledge past suffering, but the government fought to keep discussions of reparations off the agenda.
paragraphs.zh: 這些內幕是在查爾斯國王前往安地卡出席大英國協首長會議（簡稱 Chogm）時曝光的。在會議期間，他表示承認過去的痛苦是正確的，但政府卻力爭將賠償討論排除在議程之外。

paragraphs.en: While the government has reduced funding to countries that are developing rapidly, the cuts to the Commonwealth affect many very poor nations with heavy debts. For instance, Sierra Leone will see its aid reduced from nearly £30m to £5m, and Rwanda will face a similar reduction.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然政府已經減少了對快速發展國家的資金支持，但對大英國協的削減卻波及了許多負債累累的極貧國家。例如，獅子山的援助將從近 3000 萬英鎊縮減至 500 萬英鎊，而盧安達也將面臨相似的縮減。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, nature protection projects have been hit particularly hard. Experts told the Guardian that many nations have been cut off from applying to the Darwin Initiative funds, which are worth about £40m a year.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，自然保護專案受到的打擊尤其嚴重。專家告訴《衛報》，許多國家已被切斷申請價值約每年 4000 萬英鎊的達爾文倡議基金的管道。

paragraphs.en: Adrian Gahan from the Campaign for Nature charity noted that some biodiversity-rich countries facing high poverty levels will experience severe support reductions. Jean McLean from Oxfam GB stated that the government has really dropped the ball during a time of global need.
paragraphs.zh: 自然保護運動慈善機構的亞卓安·加漢指出，一些面臨高貧窮水準且生物多樣性豐富的國家將經歷嚴重的支援縮減。樂施會英國分會的珍·麥克林表示，政府在全求需求緊繃的時刻確實失職了。

grammar.explain: 用來引導形容詞子句，修飾先行詞 countries。
grammar.example: While the government has reduced funding to countries that are developing rapidly, the cuts to the Commonwealth affect many very poor nations with heavy debts.

grammar.explain: 表示主詞承受動作，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: This news was revealed by the Guardian, contrasting sharply with the warm words spoken by King Charles and Prime Minister Andy Burnham this week.

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表示動作的目的，回答「為什麼」的問題。
grammar.example: During the meeting, he stated that it was right to acknowledge past suffering, but the government fought to keep discussions of reparations off the agenda.

lessons.title: Google will let schools turn off AI, but they may also lose Search
lessons.title_zh: Google 將允許學校關閉人工智慧，但也可能失去搜尋功能

paragraphs.en: Google is introducing new rules that let schools limit students from using the company's artificial intelligence tools. However, if educational institutions decide to opt out of these features completely, they will also lose access to Google Search.
paragraphs.zh: Google 正在推出一項新規，讓學校能夠限制學生使用該公司的「人工智慧」（AI）工具。然而，如果教育機構決定完全退出這些功能，他們也將失去使用 Google 搜尋（Google Search）的管道。

paragraphs.en: This policy update arrives while numerous communities demand tighter rules regarding screen time and AI usage in schools. Many people worry that technology might harm student learning and development or create safety problems. Because of these worries, several school districts, including New York City and Los Angeles public schools, chose to ban generative artificial intelligence tools for many students this school year.
paragraphs.zh: 這項政策更新之際，許多社區正要求對學校的螢幕使用時間和人工智慧使用訂定更嚴格的規則。許多人擔心這項技術可能會損害學生的學習與發展，或造成安全問題。由於這些擔憂，包括紐約市和洛杉磯公立學校在內的幾個學區，選擇在本學年為許多學生禁止生成式人工智慧工具。

paragraphs.en: Google stated that its artificial intelligence products, such as the Gemini assistant and Google Search, will stay turned off by default for kindergarten through twelfth-grade student accounts until school administrators explicitly turn them on. This decision changes an earlier move from August when Gemini was turned on automatically inside the Google Classrooms app.
paragraphs.zh: Google 表示，其人工智慧產品（例如 Gemini 助理和 Google 搜尋）對於幼兒園到十二年級的學生帳戶將預設保持關閉，直到學校管理者明確將其開啟為止。這項決定改變了八月份時的一項早期舉措，當時 Gemini 在 Google 教室（Google Classrooms）應用程式中是自動開啟的。

paragraphs.en: Chris Phillips, who serves as the vice president of education at Google, explained to reporters that search systems and artificial intelligence are deeply connected. He mentioned that schools blocking artificial intelligence will not have access to search and will see a message indicating it is unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 擔任 Google 教育副總裁的克里斯·菲利普斯（Chris Phillips）向記者解釋，搜尋系統與人工智慧有著深厚的連結。他提到，阻擋人工智慧的學校將無法使用搜尋功能，並且會看到一則顯示其無法使用的訊息。

paragraphs.en: The technology company also introduced a guided learning principle to help students work through problems instead of simply giving them answers. Under this system, when the technology detects homework help requests, students receive step-by-step guidance rather than a single direct answer. Other technology companies are taking similar approaches to prove their products are valuable learning tools for the future workforce.
paragraphs.zh: 這家科技公司還引入了一項引導式學習原則，旨在幫助學生透過問題來學習，而不是直接給他們答案。在此系統下，當技術檢測到家庭作業求助請求時，學生會收到逐步引導，而不是單一的直接答案。其他科技公司也正採取類似的方法，來證明其產品是未來勞動市場中有價值的學習工具。

paragraphs.en: Not everyone is happy with the announcement. New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani accused the company of trying to force artificial intelligence into schools, stating in an online post that no corporation should have the power to dictate how children are taught.
paragraphs.zh: 並非所有人都對這項公告感到滿意。紐約市長佐赫蘭·馬姆達尼（Zohran Mamdani）指責該公司試圖將人工智慧強加於學校，並在網路貼文中表示，沒有任何企業應該擁有決定如何教導我們孩子的權力。

grammar.explain: 說明主詞 Chris Phillips 的身份背景，提供補充資訊。
grammar.example: Chris Phillips, who serves as the vice president of education at Google, explained to reporters that search systems and artificial intelligence are deeply connected.
grammar.focus: who serves as the vice president of education at Google

grammar.explain: 用現在分詞表達伴隨的動作或狀態。
grammar.example: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani accused the company of trying to force artificial intelligence into schools, stating in an online post that no corporation should have the power to dictate how children are taught.
grammar.focus: stating in an online post that no corporation should have the power to dictate how children are taught

grammar.explain: 表示主詞受到動作的影響，強調動作的承受者。
grammar.example: Under this system, when the technology detects homework help requests, students receive step-by-step guidance rather than a single direct answer.

lessons.title: Has Trump kept his promises to the MAHA movement?
lessons.title_zh: 川普是否兌現了他對「讓美國再次健康」運動的承諾？

paragraphs.en: A little over two years ago, Donald Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. teamed up to create the Make America Healthy Again, or MAHA, movement. Their ambitious goals included lowering rates of chronic illnesses, improving the nation's food system, and eliminating toxic chemicals. Today, supporters are divided over whether the administration has actually delivered on these major campaign promises.
paragraphs.zh: 兩年多前，唐納・川普（Donald Trump）與小羅勃・甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）聯手發起了「讓美國再次健康」（Make America Healthy Again，簡稱 MAHA）運動。他們的宏大目標包括降低慢性疾病的發病率、改善國家的食品體系，以及清除有毒化學物質。如今，支持者對於政府是否確實履行了這些重大的競選承諾意見分歧。

paragraphs.en: On one hand, the administration introduced new dietary guidelines that pleased many followers. These rules raised daily protein targets and encouraged Americans to avoid processed items while eating more saturated fat. However, environmental policies have sparked sharp disappointment. Kelly Ryerson, an activist from the nonprofit American Regeneration, argued that the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) had weakened drinking water rules and approved harmful pesticides instead of protecting public health.
paragraphs.zh: 一方面，該政府推出了讓許多支持者感到高興的新飲食指南。這些規則提高了每日蛋白質目標，並鼓勵美國人避免加工食品，同時攝取更多飽和脂肪。然而，環境政策卻引發了強烈的失望。來自非營利組織「美國再生」（American Regeneration）的倡議人士凱莉・萊爾森（Kelly Ryerson）主張，環境保護局（EPA）削弱了飲用水法規並核准有害殺蟲劑，而非保護大眾健康。

paragraphs.en: A major conflict involves glyphosate, a common chemical in weedkillers linked to cancer concerns. Although many health advocates wanted strict limits, the administration supported the chemical company in a significant Supreme Court case. Furthermore, Trump signed an executive order to boost the domestic production of this pesticide, which left numerous grassroots activists feeling betrayed.
paragraphs.zh: 一個重大的衝突牽涉到草甘膦（glyphosate），這是一種存在於除草劑中且與癌症疑慮有關的常見化學物質。儘管許多健康倡導者希望實施嚴格限制，該政府卻在一場重大的最高法院訴訟中支持該化學公司。此外，川普還簽署了一項行政命令來促進該殺蟲劑的國內生產，這讓眾多基層運動人士感到被背叛。

paragraphs.en: Health experts also doubt that chronic illnesses have decreased. Barry Popkin, a nutrition professor at the University of North Carolina, found no clear evidence of progress. Instead, he highlighted major measles outbreaks caused by anti-vaccine attitudes, along with severe foodborne illness incidents. In addition, a recent summit in Washington was filled with corporate executives, leading Ryerson to admit, "I don't even recognize this iteration of MAHA."
paragraphs.zh: 公共衛生專家也懷疑慢性疾病是否有所減少。北卡羅來納大學（University of North Carolina）的營養學教授巴里・帕普金（Barry Popkin）發現沒有任何明確的進展證據。相反地，他強調了因反疫苗態度引發的嚴重麻疹疫情，以及嚴重的食源性疾病事件。此外，近期在華盛頓舉行的一場高峰會充斥著企業高層，這讓萊爾森坦言：「我甚至認不出這個版本的 MAHA 了。」

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative clause introduced by a relative pronoun)
grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 that 所引導的形容詞子句，用來修飾先行詞 new dietary guidelines，在子句中作主詞。
grammar.example: On one hand, the administration introduced new dietary guidelines that pleased many followers.

grammar.explain: 動詞形式 had weakened... and approved... 表示該行為發生在主要子句過去式動詞 argued 之前。
grammar.example: Kelly Ryerson, an activist from the nonprofit American Regeneration, argued that the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) had weakened drinking water rules and approved harmful pesticides instead of protecting public health.
grammar.focus: had weakened drinking water rules and approved harmful pesticides

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to boost the domestic production of this pesticide 表目的，回答「簽署行政命令是為了什麼」。
grammar.example: Furthermore, Trump signed an executive order to boost the domestic production of this pesticide, which left numerous grassroots activists feeling betrayed.
grammar.focus: to boost the domestic production of this pesticide
